Pre-Solicitation Notice

1.  Purpose of Notice

This is a notice is for informational and planning purposes.   It is not a solicitation for proposals or quotations.  This notice does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service. The Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this notice.

2.  Requirement Details     

  • PRODUCT:  Pressure Gage
  • DESCRIPTION:  8-1/2", Range: 0-3000 PSIG,
  • MANUFACTURER:  HEISE MODEL A4A CM
  • SET ASIDE:  Total Small Business
  • QUANTITY:  6 each
  • NAICS:  334513
  • PSC:  6685

**SEE Ordering Data Sheet (ODS) for complete specificastions

**Certificate of Compliance will be Required

3.  Instructions for Response

Interested parties are MUST submit the following only:   Please do NOT submit quotes or pricing information at this time.

  • Company Name, Address, and Point of Contact Information (phone, email).
  • CAGE Code and Unique Entity ID (UEID).
  • Company’s Capability Statement

4.  RESPOND BY:  12 May 2026, 2:00 PM (Pacific Time)

5.  Government Point of Contact

Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility, 1400 Farragut Ave, Bremerton WA 98314

Contracting Officer:  Amanpreet (Aman) Johal, amanpreet.s.johal2.civ@us.navy.mil

Purchasing Agent:  Melissa Ayers, melissa.r.ayers3.civ@us.navy.mil
